description: A well-formed advisory naming one symbol, against a repository that really calls it. The happy path everything else is measured against.
advisory_text: fastyaml 2.x is vulnerable to remote code execution. The `unsafeLoad` function instantiates arbitrary constructors named in the YAML document, so parsing untrusted input allows an attacker to execute code. The `safeLoad` entry point is not affected. Fixed in 2.2.0.
